title: Reconstructing a Vector from Its Coordinates
statement: Let $m$ be a natural number, $x\in\bbf_2^m$, and $a,b\in\bbf_2$. The inverse of the coordinate identification $\bbf_2^{m+2}\simeq\bbf_2^m\times(\bbf_2\times\bbf_2)$ sends $(x,(a,b))$ to the vector obtained by appending $a,b$ to $x$.
